/* deliveryMapper.selectDeliveryMList : Delivery-M List(main) 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT A.* , COUNT(A.MBL_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT , SUM(A.HBL_CNT) OVER() AS SUM_HBLNO , SUM(A.HBL_PIECES) OVER() AS SUM_PIECES , SUM(A.HBL_GWT) OVER() AS SUM_GWT FROM ( SELECT MAX(ISNULL(od2.AR_DATE, '')) AS AR_DATE , MAX(ISNULL(od2.OB_DATE, '')) AS OB_DATE
, MAX(ISNULL(od2.VESSEL_FLIGHT, '')) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT , MAX(ISNULL(od2.ORIG_CODE, '')) AS ORIG_CODE , MAX(ISNULL(od2.DEST_CODE, '')) AS DEST_CODE , MAX(ISNULL(od2.MBL_NO, '')) AS MBL_NO , MAX(ISNULL(od2.OD_JOB_NO, '')) AS OD_JOB_NO , MAX(ISNULL(od2.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO, '')) AS MASTER_OD_JOB_NO , COUNT(ISNULL(od.HBL_NO, 0)) AS HBL_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_CODE, '') = '' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_UNSPECIFY_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_CODE, '') != '' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_DESIGNATE_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_CODE, '') != '' AND ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') < 'ECM340' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_WAITING_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM340' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_REQ_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM360' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_RECV_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM400' THEN 1 END) AS UNDELIVERY_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM410' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_REQ_ERR_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM420' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM361' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_PICKUP_CNT , COUNT(CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM390' THEN 1 END) AS DELIVERY_START_CNT , MAX(ISNULL(od2.BL_TYPE_MH, '')) AS BL_TYPE_MH , MAX(ISNULL(od.CUST_CODE_LV1, '')) AS AGENT_CODE , MAX(ISNULL(od2.BOUND, '')) AS BOUND , MAX(ISNULL(od2.HBL_NO, '')) AS HBL_NO , SUM(od2.PIECES) AS HBL_PIECES , SUM(od2.GWT) AS HBL_GWT
, COUNT(DISTINCT od.HBL_NO) AS TOTAL_HBL_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD od2 INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od2.OD_JOB_NO AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od2.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND od2.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'
GROUP BY od2.OD_JOB_NO )A

/* deliveryMapper.selectDeliveryHList : Delivery-H List(sub) 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT A.* , COUNT(A.HBL_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT , SUM(A.HBL_PIECES) OVER() AS SUM_PIECES , SUM(A.HBL_GWT) OVER() AS SUM_GWT , SUM(A.DELIVERY_DESIGNATE) OVER() AS SUM_DESIGNATE , SUM(A.DELIVERY_REQ) OVER() AS SUM_REQ , SUM(A.DELIVERY_REQ_ERR) OVER() AS SUM_REQ_ERR , SUM(A.DELIVERY_RECV) OVER() AS SUM_RECV , SUM(A.UNDELIVERY) OVER() AS SUM_UNDELIVERY , SUM(A.DELIVERY) OVER() AS SUM_DELIVERY , SUM(A.DELIVERY_PICKUP) OVER() AS SUM_PICKUP , SUM(A.DELIVERY_START) OVER() AS SUM_START FROM ( SELECT ad.DELIVERY_STATUS , (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = DELIVERY_STATUS AND GROUP_CODE ='STATUS_ORDER_CARGO') AS DELIVERY_STATUS_NAME , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM330' THEN 1 END AS DELIVERY_DESIGNATE , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM340' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY_REQ , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM350' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY_REQ_ERR , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM360' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY_RECV , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM361' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY_PICKUP , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM390' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY_START , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM400' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNDELIVERY , CASE ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') WHEN 'ECM420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DELIVERY , od.CD_TYPE , od.TR_CODE , od.DELIVERY_CODE , od.PO_DATE , od.AR_DATE , od.OB_DATE
, od.ORIG_CODE , od.DEST_CODE , od.PO_NO , od.HBL_NO , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME , (ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, '') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A,'') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B,'') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C,'') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D,'')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS , od.COMMODITY_ITEM , od.DELIVERY_ADDRESS_CHANGED --, od.DELIVERY_NAME_CHANGED --, od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE --, od.DELIVERY_FEE , od.SHIPPER_NAME , od.MBL_NO , od.OD_JOB_NO , od.BL_TYPE_MH , CASE WHEN pod.POD_JOB_NO IS NULL THEN pod2.DELIVERY_IRRE_CODE ELSE pod.DELIVERY_IRRE_CODE END AS DELIVERY_IRRE_CODE , CASE WHEN pod.POD_JOB_NO IS NULL THEN pod2.REMARKS ELSE pod.REMARKS END AS REMARKS , od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE , od.BOUND , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE , od.PIECES_REAL AS HBL_PIECES , od.GWT AS HBL_GWT , od.DELIVERY_FEE_NOTICE_YN , od.DELIVERY_FEE_NOTICE_DATE
, od.CB_CODE
, od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE , od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON
, od.CUST_CODE_LV1 , od.CUST_CODE_LV2
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE='ECM_DELIVERY_CODE' AND CODE = (SELECT MAX(DELIVERY_CODE) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO)) AS DELIVERY_NAME_CHANGED ,(SELECT MAX(DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED ,(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(DELIVERY_FEE) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO),0) + ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_FEE,0)) AS DELIVERY_FEE ,ISNULL((SELECT MAX(PAYMENT_GUBN) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO), od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,ad.DELIVERY_DATE
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM400' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_04 pod2 ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod2.OD_JOB_NO AND pod2.POD_STATUS = 'ECM400'
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
)A

mapper.select: /* deliveryMapper.selectAssignDeliveryExcel : */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM330' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM330' ) A ) AS ECM330_POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND (ISNULL(DELIVERY_STATUS,'') < 'ECM340' or ISNULL(DELIVERY_STATUS,'') ='ECM350') AND od.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{mblNo})) AND od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo}))

/* deliveryMapper.selectCancelDeliveryList : 오더정보 조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.HBL_NO AS blNo ,od.DELIVERY_CODE AS deliveryCode ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM350' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM350' ) A ) AS ECM350_POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* deliveryMapper.selectHoldDeliveryList : 보류 대상(마스터/선택) 조회 - 멀티건은 seqNo 단위로 전개 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,ISNULL(multi.DELIVERY_CODE, od.DELIVERY_CODE) AS deliveryCode ,multi.OD_JOB_NO AS multiOdJobNo ,multi.SEQ_NO_ID AS seqNoId ,multi.DELIVERY_NO AS deliveryNo FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* deliveryMapper.selectHoldOdJobNos : 보류 대상(검색조건) 조회 - 멀티건은 seqNo 단위로 전개 */ /* multi : 멀티 전개 + 멀티송장번호 검색 겸용 단일 조인 (if 중복 조인 제거) */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo ,od.HBL_No AS hblNo ,ISNULL(multi.DELIVERY_CODE, od.DELIVERY_CODE) AS deliveryCode ,multi.OD_JOB_NO AS multiOdJobNo ,multi.SEQ_NO_ID AS seqNoId ,multi.DELIVERY_NO AS deliveryNo FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* deliveryMapper.selectSendDeliveryListToMultiVE : Delivery 각 배송사에 해당하는 데이터 조회(반품처리용) */ SELECT mti.PAYMENT_GUBN AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE_MULTI ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItemLocConvertMulti ,mti.DIM_WIDTH AS DIM_WIDTH_MULTI ,mti.DIM_LENGTH AS DIM_LENGTH_MULTI ,mti.DIM_HEIGHT AS DIM_HEIGHT_MULTI ,od.GWT AS GWT_MULTI ,od.DIM_WIDTH AS DIM_WIDTH ,od.DIM_LENGTH AS DIM_LENGTH ,od.DIM_HEIGHT AS DIM_HEIGHT ,od.GWT AS GWT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI chkMul WHERE chkMul.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS MULTI_COUNT ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' AND BL_NO = COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) ) A ) AS ECM360_POD_JOB_NO_MULTI ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' ) A ) AS ECM360_POD_JOB_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM410' AND BL_NO = COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) --mti.DELIVERY_NO ) A ) AS ECM410_POD_JOB_NO_MULTI ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM340' AND BL_NO = COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) --mti.DELIVERY_NO ) A ) AS ECM340_POD_JOB_NO_MULTI ,(SELECT TOP 1 POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM504') AS ECM504_POD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT TOP 1 POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM504' AND BL_NO = mti.DELIVERY_NO) AS ECM504_POD_JOB_NO_MULTI , od.HBL_NO , od.OD_JOB_NO , od.HSN , od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE , od.DEST_PORT , ad.LAST_POD_STATUS , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.PO_NO AS CHK_PO_NO , CASE ISNULL(od.PO_NO,'') WHEN '' THEN od.HBL_NO ELSE od.PO_NO END PO_NO , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B , od.PIECES , od.CBM , od.GWT , od.DELIVERY_NOTE , od.AMOUNT_CUR , REPLACE((SELECT DETAIL_ITEM_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO and SEQ_NO_ID = '1'),'|','') as commodityItem1 , REPLACE((SELECT DETAIL_ITEM_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO and SEQ_NO_ID = '2'),'|','') as commodityItem2 , REPLACE((SELECT DETAIL_ITEM_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO and SEQ_NO_ID = '3'),'|','') as commodityItem3 , REPLACE((SELECT DETAIL_ITEM_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO and SEQ_NO_ID = '4'),'|','') as commodityItem4 , REPLACE((SELECT DETAIL_ITEM_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO and SEQ_NO_ID = '5'),'|','') as commodityItem5 , od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItemLocConvert , od.PIECES_REAL , od.SHIPPER_NAME AS shipperNameConvert , COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC_M, ''), (CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC,'') = '' THEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME,'') ELSE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC,'') END)) AS consigneeNameLocConvert , od.SHIPPER_ZIPCODE AS shipperZipcodeConvert , od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS + ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A,'') + ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B,'') + ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C,'') + ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D,'') AS shipperAddressLocConvert , od.SHIPPER_TEL AS shipperTelConvert , od.SHIPPER_HP AS shipperMobileConvert , COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE_M, ''), od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE) AS consigneeZipcodeLocConvert , COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC_M, ''), (LEFT(REPLACE(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, '') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, '') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, '') + ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')), '|', ' '),200))) AS consigneeAddressLocConvert , od.TR_CODE , od.DELIVERY_CODE , od.MBL_NO , od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE , od.BOUND , od.BOUND_TYPE , mti.DELIVERY_CODE AS DELIVERY_CODE_MULTI , #{registerUserId} AS registerUserId , #{registerUserName} AS registerUserName , #{gmtTime} AS gmtTime ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM340' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM340' ) A ) AS ECM340_POD_JOB_NO -- , mti.DELIVERY_NO ,COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO , mti.SEQ_NO_ID
, CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC,'') = '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC,'') = '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) END AS CONSIGNEE_HP , COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.CONSIGNEE_TEL_M, ''), (dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1))) AS consigneeHpConvert , dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS consigneeTelConvert
, CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP,'') = '' THEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_TEL,'') ELSE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP,'') END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_TEL,'') = '' THEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP,'') ELSE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_TEL,'') END AS CONSIGNEE_HP , COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.CONSIGNEE_TEL_M, ''), od.CONSIGNEE_HP) AS consigneeHpConvert , od.CONSIGNEE_TEL AS consigneeTelConvert
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mti ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mti.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1=1 AND ( ISNULL(od.HBL_NO,'') != '' OR od.DELIVERY_CODE = 'KD' )
AND (ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS,'') < 'ECM340' OR ad.DELIVERY_STATUS = 'ECM350')
AND od.DELIVERY_CODE = #{deliveryCode}
AND ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_CODE, '') != '' AND ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') < 'ECM340'
AND ad.DELIVERY_STATUS = #{srchStatus}
AND ISNULL(od.DELIVERY_CODE, '') != '' AND ISNULL(ad.DELIVERY_STATUS, '') < 'ECM340'
AND ((ISNULL(mti.OD_JOB_NO,'') = '' AND ad.DELIVERY_STATUS = #{srchDeliveryStatus}) OR (SELECT MAX(POD_STATUS) FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M pod4 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = mti.OD_JOB_NO AND BL_NO = COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO)) = #{srchDeliveryStatus})
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) = #{srchHblNo} AND mti.SEQ_NO_ID = ( SELECT MAX(sub.SEQ_NO_ID) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI sub WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(sub.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), sub.DELIVERY_NO) = #{srchHblNo} )
AND od.BOUND = 'AIR' AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' AND od.BOUND = 'AIR' AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP' AND od.BOUND = 'SEA' AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' AND od.BOUND = 'SEA' AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'
AND od.MBL_NO IN
#{item.mblNo}
AND od.OD_JOB_NO IN
#{item.odJobNo}
ORDER BY od.CUST_CODE_LV1

chkMul.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS MULTI_COUNT ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' AND BL_NO = COALESCE(NULLIF(mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED, ''), mti.DELIVERY_NO) ) A ) AS ECM360_POD_JOB_NO_MULTI ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM360' ) A ) AS ECM360_POD_JOB_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT
